experiments.gameResult: Main scene shader: Wasm 684 KB (wgsl-O-26) vs three 295 KB (wgsl-L-7), 2.3x. Root cause: the full sky graph is emitted twice (color + depth). With that removed, the op counts match three exactly. Var/let reloads (5844) and 84 select() remain as candidates.
experiments.reason: Diagnosis accepted: it names the root cause and the codegen site (standard.cpp outputDepthNode, graph.cpp Lowerer).

experiments.hypothesis: Lower color and depth outputs with one Lowerer, so the sky graph is evaluated once per fragment (identified by the WGSL diff)
experiments.bottleneckEvidence: WGSL diff: O-26 has 2 complete 148-step marches (color at :2658, depth at :10874) and 2x three's fract/dot/sin counts. outputDepthNode -> nodeValue -> graph::lower builds a fresh Lowerer with unshared memo tables.
experiments.gameResult: a1 WGSL op counts equal three's exactly (1 march). Main pass 126.0 ms (pmO, likely pre-fix) -> 77.4 / 79.4 ms (pmO2, a1; likely post-fix). Build order is unconfirmed, and no gated pair exists yet.
experiments.reason: Superseded by n1. The perf agent found that its 77/79 ms main-pass readings came from GPU contention (the parity agent's runs), not from the fix. Measured under GPU contention (another agent at 99% util); only gated runs count.

experiments.hypothesis: A constant-colour world quad still costs 13.5 ms in the main pass (fixed cost in the pass setup)
experiments.prediction: Main pass has a large fixed cost
experiments.falsifier: 1920x1080 pass under 3 ms with a constant shader
experiments.gameResult: MISREAD. The 13.5 ms was the 1152x648 cloud pass, the first pass of the frame: its begin timestamp waits for the previous present, so it grows as the other work shrinks (4.4 ms with the full world, 9.5 with a constant quad, 16 with nothing drawn). The 1920x1080 scene pass costs 2.3 ms with a constant shader, 1.9 with the world hidden, 1.5 with nothing drawn. Fixed cost of the main pass (MSAA clear, resolve, depth, formats) is at most 2 ms; the world shader is the other 36 ms.
experiments.reason: No fixed-cost lever in the main pass. Engine-only levers a-d are closed: let-shape +35%, MSAA 0.6 ms ceiling, early-Z zero ceiling, per-pass setup under 2 ms.

experiments.reason: No fixed cost to remove. The remaining 36 ms is the world shader's own ALU, the same work as in three.
